ae32c_core.description: Bounded source snapshot for a graph-first investigation of the AE-32A/B/C audit, graph, provider, and evaluation subsystems.
ae32c_core.problem_statement: Trace the static call structure from audit_engine.semantic_audit.ae32c.live_evaluation.main through provider construction, RepositoryEvidenceTools graph construction and query, RepositoryInvestigator orchestration, and comparison-artifact publication. Use the semantic graph as the navigation starting point: inspect its cross-module CALLS observations, then read at least three distinct cross-module source files surfaced by the graph before issuing broad repository searches. Follow the returned symbol names and source locations into providers.factory, AE-32B evidence tools, AE-32C investigator, and evaluation code where those paths are actually surfaced by the graph. Identify exact function-to-function CALLS relationships and source locations. Explain which edges are direct calls and which are imports, workflow invocations, or other relationships. Identify important cross-module transitions and unresolved or ambiguous call sites. Distinguish AST-derived static CALLS observations from runtime execution. Do not claim that code or tests were executed, and do not infer behavior from names alone.

review_landmarks.role: repository snapshot and graph evidence tools
